mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.5%, indicating a tight labor market, wage pressures increase, leading to higher inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broadening economic expansion, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during joint increases are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real disposable income (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a single month indicates reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical impact of income shocks on spending
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS declines sharply, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.75%, indicating a tightening monetary cycle, equity valuations are negatively impacted, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.75%, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns during joint labor market improvements are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 4% annualized rate, indicating strong economic growth, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of non-recessionary instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 4%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
